The '''Capital Reclamation and Sanitation Company Headquarters''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the main [[The Headquarters|headquarters]] for the [[Capital Reclamation and Sanitation Company]]. It was located in front of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau's]] [[ISB Central Office/Legends|building]].<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />
